## Visual world
The feel of going through case files (decision-maker, 2026-09-30): kraft-paper folders, original letters + highlighter, red stamps, evidence number tags, suspect photos, Polaroids, sticky notes. A top-down desk.

**Default style**: paper-skeuo — see ../styles/. When switching style, this file's writing sources and components stay; their look is redrawn in the new style.

## Palette
The channel's base color (from your channel profile) + a case-file paper palette:
print black #2B2622, file red #9E3B2C (multiply), fountain-pen blue-black #23324A, red pen #B8322A.

## Components
Case folder, evidence number tags, suspect letter board, Polaroid, sticky notes, stamps (mottled-ink mask). Implemented in past videos.

## Mascot and characters
- The channel mascot is the detective, holding a magnifier.
- Generated characters: not tried. Suggested prompt additions: "paper cut-out look, white cut-paper edge, soft shadow", like a photo pasted into the file.

## Signature moves and transitions
Open the next file, push an exhibit toward the camera, close with a stamp.

## Cases
A food "wrongful accusation" video (full video + thumbnail).

## Pitfalls
- LXGW WenKai is too neat, like a computer font; handwriting switched to Long Cang.
- Handwriting jitter needs ×1.4 to look human.
